title: Not As Nice As It Looks
text:
Not As Nice As It Looks. The bottle arrived in a thin cardboard box that had been put inside a flimsy, plastic envelope. The upper corner of the box was smashed in when it arrived. The bottle itself wasn't broken but the rubber stopper inside the lid of the bottle had fallen out of place and the two piece infuser had come unscrewed and separated inside the bottle. That was not an auspicious beginning but things only went downhill from there.

The neoprene cover for the bottle smelled like burnt rubber that had gasoline squirted over it. Not something you want to smell when pouring liquids out of the infuser. After I took the cover off, the glass bottle was slippery and seemed like it would be easy to drop. Sadly, the glass had a fragile feel to it, as though it would shatter easily. Without the cover, the bottle also transmitted the temperature of whatever was inside directly to your hand. In my case, it was iced tea inside the bottle and that was fine. If it had been hot tea though, my hand might have automatically jerked back. In that case I would have found out just how fragile its glass actually was. All and all I was thoroughly unimpressed with this product.
